_comment: Traditional Chinese texts for the German table kampf_k21. Keys are the English text; keys with %s or %d are patterns. Kept by hand; check with python3 tools/i18n/check_lang.py zh_TW.

strings.%d s left, then everyone without orders: 還剩%d秒，之後沒有指令的都會休息。
strings.%s is about to step out. Swap first?: 馬上要出場的是%s。先換人嗎？
strings.%s, you're up. Last longer than the last: %s，輪到你了。撐得比上一個久點。
strings.A Wayfarer names its next Spirling befor: 旅人會先說出下一隻要派出的Spirling。
strings.When a Wayfarer's Spirling is beaten, yo: 擊敗旅人的Spirling後，可以在下一隻出場前換人。
strings.You give up. %s doesn't even pretend to: 你認輸了。%s連驚訝都懶得裝。
